preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 3 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of the array a must be positive integers between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a[i] == a[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: If it is possible to make all elements equal, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.
The number of operations m must be at most n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and 1 <= k <= n and i != j and j != k and i != k for i, j, k in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must involve three distinct indices within the valid range.
